1. (Currently amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) configured to receive user input and apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, __wherein the user interface subsystem is operatively coupled to a processor system that executes instructions to establish application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image__; and
- a reporting subsystem (180) for:
i) accessing a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414),
ii) retrieving a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, and
iii) generating a report (182) based on the medical information item, __wherein the report (182) includes structured data derived from the medical information item that is specific to the particular graphical elements applied and their positions on the medical image__.

2. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information in generating the report (182) __such that the report includes machine-readable codes corresponding to the medical reference information__.

3. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user, and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element, __wherein the codified version is automatically generated based on the specific graphical element selected and its spatial relationship to image structures__.

4. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414), __wherein the macro (080) is executed by a processor to transform the medical reference information based on the application data__.

5. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro, __and wherein execution of the macro by the processor generates report content that is specific to the graphical elements applied to the medical image__.

6. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks, and wherein the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414), __wherein the hyperlinks are processed by the processor system to retrieve and display related medical information items__.

7. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412), and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay, __wherein the overlay is rendered by the processor system based on the position of the graphical elements applied to the medical image__.

8. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the application data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement, __wherein the measurement tool is implemented by the processor system to calculate and store measurement values based on user input__.

9. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) in generating the report (182), __wherein the measurement data is processed by the processor system to produce quantitative values included in the report__.

10. (Original) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066).

11. (Original) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Original) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Currently amended) A workstation or imaging apparatus comprising a processor system and the system according to claim 1, __wherein the processor system executes instructions to perform the operations of the image interface, user interface subsystem, and reporting subsystem__.

14. (Currently amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, __wherein the application data is processed by a processor system to establish a machine-readable record of the graphical elements and their positions__;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, __wherein the processor system executes a lookup operation based on the application data to identify the associated medical information item__; and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item, __wherein the processor system generates structured report content that includes information derived from the medical information item and specific to the graphical elements applied to the medical image__.

15. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
